claim: Fort Santiago hours and entrance fee (PHP 75 regular, PHP 50 discounted).
quote: Fort Santiago: Mon-Fri 8 AM–10 PM; Sat-Sun 6 AM–10 PM. Fees: PHP 75 (regular); PHP 50 (students, seniors, PWD).

claim: Casa Manila and Museo de Intramuros open Tue-Sun 9 AM–6 PM, closed Mondays.
quote: Casa Manila Museum: Closed Mondays; Tue-Sun 9 AM–6 PM. Museo de Intramuros: Closed Mondays; Tue-Sun 9 AM–6 PM.

claim: Intramuros is free public space; Museo de Intramuros has no entrance fee.
quote: Access to Intramuros itself is free as it is a public area; distinctive sites such as Fort Santiago and Casa Manila have specific entry fees.

claim: Fort Santiago accepts cash, Beep and PayMaya for the entrance fee.
quote: Payment options include cash or electronic payment methods such as Beep and PayMaya.

claim: Rizal was held 56 days at Fort Santiago and hid Mi Ultimo Adios in an oil lamp; bronze footsteps mark his final walk.
quote: The cell held Rizal for 56 days from November 3 to December 29, 1896... where he hid the poem Mi Ultimo Adios... footsteps representing his final walk... embedded onto the ground in bronze.

claim: The Museo ni Rizal (Rizal Shrine) sits inside Fort Santiago.
quote: Museo ni Rizal | Intramuros Administration.

claim: Fort Santiago is the citadel where Rizal spent his final night before his 1896 execution.
quote: the building where Rizal spent his final night and hid his famous poem Mi ultimo adios in an oil lamp.

claim: San Agustin museum costs PHP 200 (PHP 160 discounted), open daily 8-12 and 1-5 with midday closure; church free.
quote: museum entrance fee is ₱200 for regular adult visitors and ₱160 for students... opening hours for visitors are from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM, daily.

claim: San Agustin completed 1607 is the oldest stone church in the Philippines, inscribed by UNESCO in 1993.
quote: Completed in 1607, it is the oldest stone church in the country. In 1993, San Agustin Church was one of four Philippine churches... designated as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO.

claim: UNESCO Baroque Churches listing notes San Agustin's trompe-l'oeil interior, molave choir stalls and pipe organ.
quote: the symmetry and splendor of the interiors (painted by two Italians who succeeded in producing trompe-l'oeil)... the choir seats carved in molave with ivory inlays... the grand pipe organ.

claim: San Agustin Church is a declared National Historical Landmark.
quote: San Agustin Church – National Museum of the Philippines.

claim: The San Agustin crypt holds Juan Luna, Legazpi and other historical figures; lists mass schedule.
quote: The church crypt houses the remains of prominent names in Philippine history — Juan Luna, Miguel Lopez de Legazpi, Teodoro Agoncillo, Maria Orosa, and Chit Estella.

claim: Museo San Agustin (convent museum) charges around PHP 200 general admission.
quote: Museo San Agustin - reviews and visitor info, Manila, Metro Manila.

claim: Manila Cathedral is free; visit hours and mass times (Sun 8/10/6); part of Visita Iglesia.
quote: Weekdays 7:30 AM, 12:10 PM; Sunday 8:00 AM, 10:00 AM, 6:00 PM. Office Hours Tuesday-Saturday 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

claim: The UNESCO Baroque Churches group is San Agustin (Manila), Paoay, Santa Maria and Miag-ao.
quote: San Agustin Church was collectively declared... together with Paoay Church in Ilocos Norte, Santa Maria Church in Ilocos Sur, and Miag-ao Church in Iloilo.

claim: Casa Manila entrance fee is PHP 75 regular / PHP 50 discounted.
quote: The entrance fee for Casa Manila is PHP 75.00 for regular rate and PHP 50.00 for discounted rate.

claim: Listed Intramuros entrance fees for Fort Santiago and Casa Manila.
quote: LIST: Intramuros Entrance Fees for Fort Santiago, Casa Manila.

claim: Rizal Park (Luneta) is free and open daily roughly 5 AM–9 PM.
quote: Rizal Park is open daily, usually from 5:00 AM to 9:00 PM... There is no entrance fee required to enter Rizal Park.

claim: Rizal Park is ~58 hectares, centred on the Rizal Monument marking the execution spot, guarded by ceremonial sentries.
quote: The Rizal Monument stands as the park's centerpiece, marking the exact spot where Dr. Rizal was executed... an area of about 58 hectares.

claim: National Museum complex (Fine Arts, Anthropology, Natural History) is open daily 9 AM–6 PM with free admission; Spoliarium and Lolong.
quote: The museum is now open seven days a week from 9 AM to 6 PM... Entrance is free for all visitors.

claim: Binondo, founded 1594, is the world's oldest Chinatown and a foodie quarter best explored on a food crawl.
quote: Binondo is the world's oldest Chinatown... It was established in 1594 by Spanish colonisers as a permanent settlement for Chinese traders who had converted to Christianity.

claim: Binondo Church (Minor Basilica of San Lorenzo Ruiz, founded 1596) is free to enter.
quote: the Minor Basilica and National Shrine of San Lorenzo Ruiz, popularly known as the Binondo Church, founded by Dominican priests in 1596.

claim: Binondo landmarks include the giant Chinatown Arch (2015), Ongpin Street and To Ho Panciteria (est. 1888).
quote: Manila Chinatown Arch... said to be the world's largest Chinatown arch... To Ho Panciteria Antigua, established in 1888... the oldest operating panciteria in the Philippines.

claim: The 2026 Black Nazarene Traslacion to Quiapo Church lasted over 30 hours along a 5.8 km route.
quote: The Black Nazarene arrived at Quiapo Church more than 30 hours after the Traslacion began... thronged the 5.8-kilometer route.

claim: Quiapo set the 2026 Traslacion for 9 January with a defined procession route.
quote: Quiapo sets 2026 Traslacion schedule, procession route.

claim: The 2026 Nazareno drew about 9.64 million devotees per Quiapo Church.
quote: Nazareno 2026 draws 9.64M devotees — Quiapo Church.

claim: San Sebastian (completed 1891) is the only all-steel church in Asia, painted to resemble marble and jasper.
quote: the only steel building church in the Philippines, and it is the first all-steel church in Asia... painted... to give the appearance of marble and jasper.

claim: San Sebastian Church is free and open daily roughly 6 AM–8 PM.
quote: visiting hours are Monday through Sunday from 6:00 am to 8:00 pm.

claim: Sun Cruises ferry shut post-pandemic; a direct Manila->Corregidor day-tour ferry relaunched 1 March 2026 (Guia Del'Mar/Prestige) from the CCP Complex, 50-pax minimum, book >=2 weeks ahead; Sun Cruises packages ran PHP 3,400-4,500.
quote: A direct Manila to Corregidor Ferry Tour launched on March 1, 2026, through Travel and Tours Guia Del'Mar in partnership with Prestige Cruises... booking must be made at least 2 weeks prior... Boarding... inside the Cultural Center of the Philippines Complex.

claim: The main alternative Corregidor tour runs from Mariveles, Bataan (Villa Carmen), join-in ~$50, morning/midday departures, advance booking mandatory, no food sold on island.
quote: Villa Carmen in Mariveles, Bataan... Join-In Tour: $50... Morning Tour: 8:00 AM departure, 1:50 PM return... All guests must book before arrival... No food and drinks available on the island.

claim: Guia Del'Mar operates Corregidor Island day tours covering the historical landmarks.
quote: Corregidor Island Tour - Explore 5 Powerful Historical Landmarks in the Philippines.

claim: Taal crater island has been off-limits since 2020 (alert-level dependent); only boat rides/viewpoints; boats PHP 2,500-3,000, all-in Manila tour ~US$125.
quote: Nobody has been allowed on Taal volcano now for over three years... boats to Volcano Island cost 2,500-3,000 PHP... A Taal Volcano day tour... costs around US$125.

claim: Bookable Tagaytay and Taal Volcano day trips with boat ride depart from Manila.
quote: Private Tour: Tagaytay Midlands & Taal Volcano Boat Ride 2026 - Manila.

claim: Las Pinas Bamboo Organ church is free; the museum costs PHP 200 with discounts; guided tours available.
quote: Entry to the church itself is generally free, however, there is a fee of 200 PHP to enter the museum dedicated to the Bamboo Organ.

claim: The Las Pinas bamboo organ was built by Fr. Diego Cera in the early 1800s.
quote: the Diocesan Shrine and Parish of Saint Joseph, commonly known as Las Pinas Church or Bamboo Organ Church.

claim: The bamboo organ has 1,031 pipes, was completed 1821 by Fr. Diego Cera, named a National Cultural Treasure in 2003; tours include a mini-concert.
quote: the world's most famous bamboo pipe organ, with 1,031 pipes... completed in 1821... In 2003, it received official recognition as a National Cultural Treasure.

claim: The 51st International Bamboo Organ Festival runs 15 Feb–1 Mar 2026.
quote: The 51st International Bamboo Organ Festival is scheduled for February 15 to March 1, 2026.

claim: Coconut Palace is a Manila landmark in the CCP complex on Roxas Boulevard.
quote: Coconut Palace - all you should know before you go, Manila, Metro Manila.

claim: Coconut Palace is built largely of coconut wood with seven regional rooms; visits are by advance free appointment via GSIS, ~1 hour.
quote: you typically need a permit to enter the Coconut Palace... tours must be arranged in advance through the Government Service Insurance System... around 1 hour.

claim: Manila Baywalk on Roxas Boulevard (with Dolomite Beach, built 2020-2022) is a free sunset spot; arrive ~4:30 PM.
quote: Manila Baywalk on Roxas Boulevard is famed for its stunning sunsets... Arrive by 4:30 PM to secure a good spot... Dolomite Beach... constructed between 2020 and 2022.

claim: Best time to visit Manila is the dry season Dec–Apr (~24-31C); avoid Jul–Oct wet/typhoon season when streets flood.
quote: the dry season between January and April... December, January and February are popular months as they are drier and cooler... skip the wetter months.

claim: Philippines is dry Dec–May and wet Jun–Nov, with typhoons typically Jul–Oct.
quote: It's dry from December to May and wet from June to November... typhoons (generally during the months of July - October).

claim: Bambike Ecotours runs guided bamboo-bike tours of 8-10 Intramuros sites; the Intramuros Experience is ~3 hours and includes Fort Santiago entry; sunset and night editions; Tue-Sun.
quote: the full Intramuros Experience (a three-hour guided tour that includes entry to Fort Santiago)... the Intramuros Sunset Tour... Guided tours are offered from Tuesday to Sunday.

claim: Intramuros is free to enter as public space; only specific sites (Fort Santiago, Casa Manila, Baluarte de San Diego) charge.
quote: Access to Intramuros itself is free as it is a public area, however, distinctive sites within Intramuros... have specific entry fees.
